mainEntity.name: What is a top crypto marketing agency and is it the right fit for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A top crypto marketing agency handles some combination of earned-media PR, growth and community, and KOL distribution for Web3 projects. Which type is right depends on where your biggest gap is. For most early-stage founders, earned-media PR is the highest-leverage starting point because press coverage in outlets like CoinDesk, Decrypt or Forbes underpins investor credibility and AI-search visibility. Shilika Jain runs that track directly as a fractional senior operator, without an account team between you and the editor.

mainEntity.name: How much does a top crypto marketing agency cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service crypto PR agencies typically charge $15K–$45K/month to fund a multi-person account team. Growth-focused agencies run $8K–$20K/month. KOL campaigns vary by creator tier: nano ($200–$1.5K per creator), micro ($500–$5K), mid-tier ($10K–$30K) and macro ($25K–$100K+). A fractional senior PR operator runs the same earned-media scope as a full agency for $5K–$12K/month, and a focused launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can a crypto PR operator actually deliver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream where the angle warrants: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Coverage depends on a genuine news hook pitched directly to an editor who knows your beat. Wire distribution alone does not produce these placements.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from a crypto marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: For earned-media PR, the highest-leverage work happens in the six to twelve weeks before a public moment such as a mainnet, raise, listing or TGE. A well-prepared embargo can produce tier-1 placements on day one of launch, as it did for RARI Chain (11 tier-1 placements in 24 hours). Ongoing retainer work compounds over three to six months as editor relationships deepen and your narrative becomes the reference point for your category.
